name: AltTexting
description: Adds AI-generated alt text to media images (accessibility assist).
project_description:
ALTtext.ing helps site builders and content editors ensure that all images on a Drupal website include meaningful alternative text. The module makes it easier to comply with accessibility standards and provide a better user experience for everyone.

 Features 
 - Detects images without alternative text.

- Provides editors with simple tools to add or update alt text during content creation or on media entity edit.

- Improves SEO by encouraging consistent use of descriptive alt attributes.

- Useful for any Drupal site that manages lots of media or editorial contributors.

 

 Additional Requirements 
 you need a license key for the alttext.ing service from acolono GmbH

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 We recommend the Module Entity Reference Media to also support overwriting the alt text wherever you use it.

With that also the surrounding context of the Media item is passed over and therefore also the quality of the alt text is getting significantly better.
